messages:
slo-bot: SLO alert — hosted-infer.euw1: p99 latency > 5s and 5xx fraction rose to 2.8% over the last 30m. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/hosted-infer

sre-oncall: jumping in, looking at the topology panels now. I see a steady increase starting ~09:08 UTC. Probe traffic looks normal.

micah: confirmed. gateway timeouts + 502s from ingress proxy. Traces are thin — many failing requests have no downstream spans.

anya: do we have any request ids from customer reports? support posted a sample: req_id=rcp-7f92a1.

jordan: pulled logs for req_id=rcp-7f92a1 — gateway shows CONNECT timeout to prefetch service, then upstream 502. Loki query I used:
```
{job=\"gateway\"} | json | req_id=\"rcp-7f92a1\" | line_format \"{{.level}} {{.msg}}\"
```
Quick snippet of gateway log for that id: 
```
ERROR gateway: dial tcp prefetch.euw1: connect: i/o timeout (handshake) req_id=rcp-7f92a1
WARN gateway: returning 502 to client req_id=rcp-7f92a1
```

observability-bot: tracing note — sampling rate for /v1/infer route is 5%. During this spike 72% of failed requests had no sampled spans (trace gap).

micah: reproducer attempt from within cluster (will paste):
```
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDBOX_TOKEN\" -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-alpha\",\"input\":\"short test\"}' https://hosted-infer.euw1.redwood/api/v1/infer
```
Result: repeated requests intermittently return HTTP 502 or hang >10s. When it returns 502 logs show connect timeout to prefetch pool.

anya: interesting: hitting the dedicated-fallback endpoint for same model works (low latency). Points to a prefetch/pool or gateway issue rather than model exec.

jordan: current hypothesis: prefetch pool (prefetcher/batcher) overloaded causing connection handshakes to fail — likely connection churn plus KV-cache miss storm. Metrics: prefetch_connection_attempts ↑, prefetch_active_backlog ↑, kvcache_miss_rate spiking to 65%.

support-esc: customer \"AcmeCorp\" reporting timeouts since 08:45 UTC; they provided timestamps and request ids. They've requested ETA and mitigation steps.

micah: mitigation plan I'm applying now: (1) increase prefetch pool concurrency soft quota by +20% for euw1 (2) temporarily lower batch size to reduce handshake pressure (3) trigger a controlled rolling restart of prefetch workers with 10s camera delay so we don't thunderdome.

anya: also enabling a trace-sampling override for /v1/infer to 50% for 30m to reduce trace gap and capture failing request spans. observability-bot, please annotate traces for this thread.

observability-bot: annotated. Added dashboard panel showing prefetch handshake latencies and kvcache hit/miss ratio.

jordan: added a quick Loki query and alert tweak: widen the detection window for connect timeouts to reduce alert noise but retain SLO triggers. Query used as alert source:
```
{job=\"gateway\"} | json | connect_error = \"i/o timeout\" | count_over_time(1m)
```

sre-oncall: infra ticket created INC-123456 (prefetch pool handshake errors in euw1). Pinging infra lead @will for capacity checks and network flattening.

micah: initial results — after increasing pool concurrency and reduced batch size, failed 502s dropped from 2.8% -> 0.9% over 8 minutes. KV-cache miss rate slowly coming down after warm attempts.

support-esc: relayed mitigation to AcmeCorp. They confirmed reduced timeouts for one of their requests; monitoring their UX.

anya: follow-ups/actions: [1] run kv-cache warm sweep across hot prefixes (2) add a synthetic probe hitting prefetch handshake to detect early i/o timeout regression (3) postmortem if recurrence > 3x in 24h (4) consider connection pool tuning + keepalive tweaks for prefetcher.

jordan: note for postmortem: add the Loki queries, a timeline of prefetch_active_backlog vs kvcache_miss_rate, and trace coverage percentages.

sre-oncall: marking thread P1 -> transitioning to mitigation phase. Will update INC-123456 with runbook steps and hand off to oncall-asia for overnight watch. :thumbsup:

micah: leaving a short repro and quick diagnostic commands for whoever picks this up:
```
# collect gateway slow dials (last 30m)
loki query: {job=\"gateway\"} | json | level=\"ERROR\" | line_format \"{{.ts}} {{.msg}}\" | regexp \"dial tcp.*i/o timeout\"
# list prefetch pool backpressure
prometheus: prefetch_active_backlog{region=\"euw1\"}
# kvcache hits
prometheus: kvcache_hit_rate{region=\"euw1\",model=\"redwood-alpha\"}
```

anya: thanks — if we can get a small playbook slapped onto the incident ticket (auto-scaling knob + cache-warm script) we can reduce mean time to mitigate next time.

support-esc: customer escalation closed for now; they will reopen if they see regressions.

sre-oncall: closing thread for now but keeping INC-123456 open for follow-up. Will convert to postmortem doc if we see recurrence.
